initial_hypothesis: Low monthly use mainly reflects episodic dealer jobs
initial_rival: Preventable friction deters repeated useful use
status_scope: The dominant cause of low monthly use was not identified.
assessment: Episodic jobs and useful booking accounts exist; a current multi-vehicle limitation is also reported.
strongest_countercase: Preventable friction remains a credible rival; low-use owner anecdotes are not a Digiroom cohort.
remaining_identification_gap: Need job-due activity, repeated task attempts, nonusers and completed outcomes.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: WhatsApp preserves useful conversational context and exception handling
initial_rival: Users bypass Digiroom because ordinary tasks are hard
status_scope: Complementary app/human use is reported; context preservation and relative superiority remain unresolved.
assessment: One BYD owner reports app booking with WhatsApp reminders; a historical Auto2000 project reports assisted-channel preference.
strongest_countercase: The example may be complementary reminders rather than exception handling; current unresolved chat is also reported.
remaining_identification_gap: Need equivalent tasks, exceptions, preserved context, adviser effort and outcomes by chosen channel.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Digital lead context is not consistently actionable at the branch
initial_rival: Leads are processed well but demand is unsuitable or unfinanceable
status_scope: Actual Digiroom-to-branch lead actionability was not observed.
assessment: Published/request states and alleged mToyota booking episodes justify separating request from confirmation.
strongest_countercase: Positive mToyota accounts and an unsubmitted Auto2000 preview cannot establish an Auto2000 routing failure.
remaining_identification_gap: Need source-linked lead IDs, assignment/contact timestamps, qualification and delivery records.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Existing feature fragmentation creates an integration opportunity larger than feature expansion
initial_rival: Customers understand app roles and prefer differentiated channels
status_scope: Advertised job overlap is supported; harmful fragmentation or an integration opportunity larger than expansion is unresolved.
assessment: OEM, dealer and partner routes advertise overlapping purchase and ownership jobs.
strongest_countercase: Clear complementary roles may already work; cross-app data entry and customer confusion were not tested.
remaining_identification_gap: Need complete matched cross-property tasks, repeated inputs and customer outcomes.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: A lack of situation-specific cost comparisons increases purchase uncertainty
initial_rival: Price/credit constraint dominates despite complete understanding
status_scope: Existing comparison and finance functions were observed; effects of situation-specific cost support were not measured.
assessment: The comparison completed and the simulator exposed a repeatable insurance/cash-flow trade-off without personal contact data.
strongest_countercase: Affordability and model fit may bind despite good information; an airbag representation error does not make the entire comparison unusable.
remaining_identification_gap: Need buyer comprehension/choice evidence separating information, affordability and available offers.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Toyota/Auto2000 loses some prospects before inquiry because its offer does not fit their desired vehicle class
initial_rival: A competitive offer exists but is difficult to discover
status_scope: No lost-before-inquiry population or like-for-like lost-shortlist outcome was observed.
assessment: Narratives and choice research make budget, service access and offer fit plausible constraints.
strongest_countercase: A relevant offer may exist but be poorly found; publicly observed prices need exact variant/location matching.
remaining_identification_gap: Need rejection reasons, actual available inventory, credit, shortlists and deliveries.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: HEV maintenance contact protects some ownership opportunities despite BEV market growth
initial_rival: Owners defect, defer work or have fewer eligible jobs irrespective of powertrain
status_scope: HEV engine maintenance and eligible scheduled-service programs are supported; protected commercial capture is unmeasured.
assessment: HEV contact opportunities cannot be inferred from BEV maintenance economics alone.
strongest_countercase: Owners can defer or move service despite technical need or program eligibility.
remaining_identification_gap: Need installed-base cohorts, mileage, entitlement, jobs due, dealer capture and realized contribution.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: BEV ownership value shifts toward selected infrequent, high-consequence needs
initial_rival: Generic routine engagement remains the profitable driver
status_scope: BEV reduction in some routine work is supported; profitable infrequent unmet jobs remain unresolved.
assessment: Technical and published capability evidence identifies distinct diagnostic, battery and emergency jobs.
strongest_countercase: Needs may already be served, infrequent, OEM-controlled or unprofitable for Auto2000.
remaining_identification_gap: Need unmet-job incidence, willingness to use/pay, actual capability and contribution.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Service-history completeness and finalization matter more than simple history availability
initial_rival: Historical complaints concern old versions or isolated data
status_scope: A current widespread Digiroom history problem or its relative importance was not established.
assessment: Historical usability findings and record-value narratives separate feature existence from scope and completeness.
strongest_countercase: Older app builds, account linkage or normal completion lag may explain accounts; positive history experiences exist.
remaining_identification_gap: Need current version/account tests, repair-order timing and record lineage.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Quote/invoice differences create avoidable uncertainty at a transition between digital and branch
initial_rival: Legitimate inspections, discounts and authorized scope explain changes
status_scope: Historical app/receipt differences and legitimate estimate transitions are documented; current avoidable uncertainty remains unresolved.
assessment: One historical study reports a branch-discount/app mismatch; current operator terms explicitly make estimates conditional.
strongest_countercase: Inspection, authorized scope or disclosed financing choices can legitimately change amounts.
remaining_identification_gap: Need linked estimate, authorization, discount, invoice and customer interpretation for current jobs.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Showing task-specific branch capability earlier can reduce wrong routing
initial_rival: Routing already prevents errors; displayed generic copy has no operational consequence
status_scope: A local capability route was observed, without wrong-routing or reduced-travel outcomes.
assessment: B&P branch search returned a specialist branch; competitor terms show service geographies differ by task.
strongest_countercase: An initial no-branch state was resolved by another locality; it is not universal failure.
remaining_identification_gap: Need actual wrong-branch contacts, reassignments, capability and travel outcomes.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Scarce EV technician/bay capacity limits value from additional digital demand
initial_rival: Idle capable capacity is the constraint-free growth opportunity
status_scope: EV skill/bay utilization and displaced contribution were unavailable.
assessment: Advertised emergency coverage and staff accounts indicate operational conditions worth examining.
strongest_countercase: Published capability, disabled calendar or general workload do not identify scarcity; idle capacity is possible.
remaining_identification_gap: Need job/hour/skill capacity, demand, utilization and margin of displaced work.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Parts compatibility uncertainty blocks some viable purchases
initial_rival: Low demand, stock or delivery economics dominate
status_scope: No sufficiently complete compatible-parts purchase and nonpurchase evidence was collected.
assessment: Parts costs and maintenance vary, but that does not establish compatibility as a blocking mechanism.
strongest_countercase: Stock, price, lead time or low demand could dominate.
remaining_identification_gap: Need fitment task evidence, returns/errors, inventory and completed-order contribution.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Body/paint is an under-connected ownership job in digital discovery
initial_rival: Customer demand is already routed mainly through insurers and referrals
status_scope: B&P presence and specialist discovery are observed; under-connection or lost jobs is unmeasured.
assessment: Auto2000 has a B&P route and a specialist branch result; insurer/issuer attribution matters in repair narratives.
strongest_countercase: Existing insurer/referral routes may already perform well; viral cost claims have unresolved provenance.
remaining_identification_gap: Need incident-to-contact/authorization/repair outcomes and net contribution.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Household roles create a need for shareable, consistent decision evidence
initial_rival: One individual typically decides and pays without coordination friction
status_scope: Household role and practical-fit differences are present in narratives; demand for a shareable artifact is unproven.
assessment: Family preferences, a second household vehicle and spouse-related finance inputs indicate distinct roles.
strongest_countercase: One decision maker may still coordinate easily; mandatory finance documents are not evidence of coordination friction.
remaining_identification_gap: Need direct coordination burden, sharing behavior and task/choice consequences.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Fleet administrators value approval and multi-vehicle continuity more than individual app frequency
initial_rival: Existing B2B channels fully solve their needs
status_scope: Fleet administrator priorities relative to individual engagement were not established.
assessment: A consumer multi-car booking limit is reported; one subscription FAQ restricts personal use.
strongest_countercase: Neither proves fleet demand or inadequacy of existing specialist B2B channels.
remaining_identification_gap: Need fleet-specific process evidence, approvals, downtime and contract economics.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Requesting some data before proving task value creates avoidable trust friction
initial_rival: Those fields are necessary to establish a credible offer
status_scope: Different tasks impose different data boundaries; causal trust/abandonment effects were not measured.
assessment: Finance and test-drive previews expose value before contact; workshop and appraisal previews stop at vehicle/plate requirements.
strongest_countercase: Those fields may be necessary for credible qualification; not every task gates value behind identity.
remaining_identification_gap: Need field purpose, eligibility effect, comprehension, consent and task outcome evidence.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Site information inconsistencies arise from distributed publishing governance
initial_rival: Legitimate year, variant, location and offer differences explain them
status_scope: Representation anomalies were observed; distributed-governance causation and exact entity conflicts remain unresolved.
assessment: An implausible filter limit, TRUE airbag field and a navigation Rp0 value are bounded representation issues.
strongest_countercase: Price differences may reflect date/variant/offer scope; navigation placeholders are not confirmed free offers.
remaining_identification_gap: Need matched entity/version joins and publishing ownership/update process; no indexing or revenue effect inferred.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Useful content already exists but is disconnected from the relevant next action
initial_rival: Content intent is informational and requires no commercial transition
status_scope: Existing content and next-step routes are visible; disconnected relevant actions were not established broadly.
assessment: Useful capabilities exist in several properties and tasks.
strongest_countercase: Informational pages may legitimately need no immediate commercial action; successful routes are countercases.
remaining_identification_gap: Need balanced query-to-answer-to-action tasks and actual assisted transitions.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: A ranking or traffic issue is less valuable than resolving high-intent decision uncertainty
initial_rival: Important offers are materially undiscoverable
status_scope: Relative commercial value of acquisition versus decision support cannot be ranked from this public sample.
assessment: Decision uncertainty is plausible, while raw metadata alone cannot establish search losses.
strongest_countercase: High-intent discoverability may be the larger problem; no Search Console or conversion cohort was available.
remaining_identification_gap: Need comparable exposure, intent, search and transaction data; source ordering is not Google rank.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: An incentive or credit-allocation conflict discourages staff use of Single ID
initial_rival: Staff face data quality, training or workflow constraints instead
status_scope: Staff incentive or Single ID credit-allocation conflict was not directly observed.
assessment: Staff-role accounts raise workload, documentation and price-authority questions.
strongest_countercase: Data quality, training or ordinary workflow could explain difficulty; no compensation policy or Single ID usage audit exists.
remaining_identification_gap: Need authorized policy and process evidence; role-play is not stakeholder testimony.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Small high-value lifecycle moments may outperform frequent low-value engagement
initial_rival: Frequent use creates measurable trust or retention benefits
status_scope: Relative incremental value of rare lifecycle moments versus frequent engagement was not measured.
assessment: Distinct job cadence and eligibility transitions are plausible commercially meaningful moments.
strongest_countercase: Useful frequent interaction may build independent value; low-mileage anecdotes do not settle app economics.
remaining_identification_gap: Need comparable all-channel cohorts and contribution outcomes, accounting for intent selection.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: A digital initiative mostly migrates existing Auto2000 transactions across channels
initial_rival: It wins incremental customers/work or reduces realized servicing costs
status_scope: The share of digital volume that is migration versus incremental remains unidentified.
assessment: A zero-increment migration counterexample is mathematically valid; a useful digital task was observed.
strongest_countercase: Digital may win additional sales, capture or realizable efficiency; no all-channel counterfactual is available.
remaining_identification_gap: Need all-channel completed contribution and cost-to-serve comparison; app share alone is insufficient.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: Battery-health evidence is most useful when attached to a purchase/trade-in decision
initial_rival: Owners mainly want reassurance regardless of transaction stage
status_scope: Existing transaction-relevant battery evidence is supported; its highest-value stage was not identified.
assessment: Condition information, protection and appraisal uncertainty plausibly interact.
strongest_countercase: Owners may value reassurance independently; scores may already be understood and priced in.
remaining_identification_gap: Need stage-specific certificate use, actual appraisal/choice outcomes and competing uncertainty measures.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation

initial_hypothesis: A hybrid-heavy installed base allows a different near-term profit strategy from a BEV-heavy new-sales narrative
initial_rival: Fast BEV growth already changes near-term dealer fleet economics
status_scope: Different flow/stock and powertrain economics are supported; Auto2000 installed-base exposure remains unknown.
assessment: Market-mix arithmetic can change aggregate share without segment underperformance; HEV/BEV needs differ.
strongest_countercase: Rapid BEV adoption could already change the relevant cohort; national new-sales data do not resolve dealer stock.
remaining_identification_gap: Need vehicle-in-use cohorts, age/mileage, retention and actual jobs/contribution.
assessor: independent AI research agent; source-grounded review, not human validation
